claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS is an anchor box free and proposal free object detector.
claims.evidence_quote_short: our proposed detector FCOS is anchor box free, as well as proposal free.

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS with ResNeXt-64x4d-101 achieves 44.7% AP with single-model and single-scale testing.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS with ResNeXt-64x4d-101 achieves 44.7% in AP with single-model and single-scale testing

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS outperforms RetinaNet with the same backbone ResNet-101-FPN by 2.4% in AP.
claims.evidence_quote_short: our FCOS outperforms the RetinaNet with the same backbone ResNet-101-FPN by 2.4% in AP

claims.claim_text_normalized: The center-ness branch improves AP from 33.5% to 37.1%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: the center-ness branch can boost AP from 33.5% to 37.1%

claims.claim_text_normalized: Multi-level prediction with FPN reduces the ratio of ambiguous samples from 23.16% to 7.14%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: with FPN, the ratio can be significantly reduced to only 7.14%

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS completely avoids hyper-parameters related to anchor boxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS completely avoids the complicated computation related to anchor boxes such as calculating overlapping during training.

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS as a Region Proposal Network improves AR100 to 52.8% over the baseline RPN with FPN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS further boosts AR100 and AR1k respectively to 52.8% and 60.3%

claims.claim_text_normalized: Detection performance of anchor-based detectors is sensitive to the sizes, aspect ratios and number of anchor boxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: detection performance is sensitive to the sizes, aspect ratios and number of anchor boxes.
